stem: Monique’s asthma care has been guided by a paediatric respiratory physician, and she asks when she will need to be seen by an adult doctor. What would you tell Monique about transition planning?

options.text: Transition planning is a gradual process that eventually leads to transfer of care to adult services
All patients must be transitioned to adult care by 18 years of age with some exceptions
New patients over the age of 16 should be seen by adult physicians
Transition planning involves the patient/young person understanding and managing his/her medical care

explanation: Transition in chronic disease care is a planned, gradual process that prepares the young person for adult services and culminates in transfer of care. The best answer here is the statement that transition planning is gradual and leads to transfer to adult services.

citations.title: Practice Quiz: Asthma Management: Medications and Devices - Part B

rationale: Transition is a process, not a single event, and involves preparing the young person for adult-oriented care before transfer.

optionExplanations.A: Correct: transition is a gradual process that prepares for eventual transfer to adult services.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect: there is no universal rule that all patients must be transferred by 18; timing should be individualised.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect: age 16 alone does not mandate adult physician care for new patients.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect: this is an important part of transition, but it is not the best overall definition compared with option A.

Instructions

Question 6 & 7 relate to this case

Asthma Management: Medications and Devices - Case 3

Monique is a 16 year old girl with a previous history of well controlled persistent asthma. Over the last few months she has had more symptoms than usual, with a fall in her lung function confirmed on testing today. When questioned directly, Monique admits that she forgot to take her fluticasone (Flixotide) 3-4 days last week. She carries her salbutamol (Ventolin) in her bag and has used that 4 times in the last week.
